name: @huddle/game-voting
description: Voting Game Module: the deliberately simple second game — a prompt-and-vote loop that proves the platform is game-independent.
//exports: `./logic` is the rules without the screens, so the Convex server imports them without bundling React Native — the same seam trivia draws, and for the same reason (see packages/games/trivia/package.json).
//peerDependencies: Screens only. `react-native` resolves to whichever variant the consuming app installed — react-native-tvos on the TV, stock on the phone — and the `./logic` entry point imports none of it, which is what lets the Convex server take the rules alone. See packages/games/trivia/package.json.
